text.p: Fortress Group Inc declared a $0.0025 initial quarterly cash dividend on its common stock, payable on May 1, 1997 to shareholders of record March 31, 1997.
The company said it plans to increase this dividend in the future as it grows. It said it hopes to be able to make annual increases.

"Because we are in a rapid growth phase, we have initiated our dividend at only one cent per year," said Fortress president and chief executive officer James J. Martell. "We want this dividend, in addition to allowing a broader spectrum of investors, to become shareholders, to serve as a signal that creating shareholder value is important to us and we intend to continue to reward our shareholders as The Fortress Group develops."
